sloka: राज्य कामे मम क्रोधो भरते यो बभूव ह ।तम् विराधे विमोक्ष्यामि वज्री वज्रम् इव अचले ॥३-२-२५॥
transliteration: rājya kāme mama krodho bharate yo babhūva ha ।tam virādhe vimokṣyāmi vajrī vajram iva acale ॥3-2-25॥

translations.english: Like Indra who hits the mountain with his thunderbolt, I shall release on Viradha the anger I felt against Bharata for his passion for the kingdom.
